Uniform |y| on [0,b] makes R_M>=r a single interval sqrt(r^2-a^2/4)<=|y|<=b-r for a/2<r<=a; its length gives the survival formula. Expansion at a/2 proves the square-root cusp, plateau gives cylinder atom and the thick-band a atom; crossing the monotone barriers yields 3 sharp maxima regimes. Infinite inverse classification uses slope 1/b and cusp/jump at a/2. Independent deck checks on 5 geometry pairs and 25 CDF midpoint evaluations corroborate only.
